functionalRequirement: In the Facebook settings menu, the system shall allow the user to delete their saved username and password for Facebook.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide a fully functional option to delete saved username and password for 100% of users accessing the Facebook settings menu.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to offer a complete feature for deleting saved credentials, ensuring all users can perform this action.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must ensure that the deletion of saved username and password is irreversible and permanently removes all traces of the credentials from the system.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling sensitive user data, requiring secure and permanent deletion to protect user privacy.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and easily accessible option to delete saved username and password within the Facebook settings menu.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires user interaction with the settings menu, necessitating ease of operation for users.

functionalRequirement: System shall request a deposit of Rs. 5000 upon entry of valid customer information and update it temporarily in the customer database.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately validate customer information and request the deposit of Rs. 5000 for 100% of valid entries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires precise validation and deposit handling, ensuring correctness in processing customer information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must process and update the customer database with the deposit information within 500 milliseconds of receiving valid customer information.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time database updates, requiring timely processing for efficient operation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to process deposit requests and update the customer database for 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous processing of deposit requests, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that the deposit information is securely stored and cannot be tampered with during the temporary update in the customer database.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling financial data, requiring protection against unauthorized modifications.

functionalRequirement: The system shall generate reports on storage consumption by financial contact.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must generate storage consumption reports for 100% of financial contacts in the database.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive reporting, ensuring all financial contacts are included.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must generate storage consumption reports within 5 seconds for up to 10,000 financial contacts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves generating reports, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Appropriateness Recognizability: The system must present storage consumption reports in a clear and understandable format, such as tables or charts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires users to interpret reports, necessitating clarity and recognizability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow for easy modification of report generation logic to accommodate changes in storage consumption metrics.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves generating reports, requiring flexibility to adapt to evolving requirements.

functionalRequirement: The system shall be able to generate a series of multiple-choice fraction questions that form a cohesive storyline to introduce a specific topic.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must generate multiple-choice fraction questions that cover 100% of the specified topic's key concepts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive question generation, ensuring all key concepts are addressed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must ensure that the generated questions and storyline are easy to understand and follow for users with basic knowledge of fractions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves educational content, requiring ease of learning for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: The system must generate questions and storylines that are engaging and interactive to maintain user interest.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves educational content, requiring user engagement to enhance learning effectiveness.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow for easy updates to the question bank and storyline to reflect changes in the topic or educational standards.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves generating educational content, requiring flexibility to adapt to evolving requirements.

functionalRequirement: System shall display a confirmation popup after the user fills out the form and clicks the submit button, saving the information to the database for further processing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must display a confirmation popup and save form information for 100% of valid form submissions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires complete handling of form submissions, ensuring all valid inputs are processed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must display the confirmation popup and save form information within 300 milliseconds of the submit button being clicked.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time user interaction, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must validate form inputs before submission and prevent saving if any required fields are incomplete or invalid.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves form submission, requiring protection against user errors to ensure data integrity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to process form submissions and display confirmation popups for 99.95% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous form processing, necessitating high availability.
